Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth

Class RegisteredJwksClientAssertionDecoderFactory

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth.RegisteredJwksClientAssertionDecoderFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoderFactory<org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.authorization.client.RegisteredClient>
public class RegisteredJwksClientAssertionDecoderFactory extends Object implements org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoderFactory<org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.authorization.client.RegisteredClient>
Creates the decoder of the client assertions of a client. A client with a registered JWK set (settings.client.jwks) is verified against those keys; any other client goes through the framework's factory, which reads the keys of its jwkSetUrl (or the shared secret of client_secret_jwt). Both add the framework's default assertion validators (issuer, subject, audience including the PAR endpoint, expiry) and the ReplayRejectingJwtValidator. The framework's own factory caches a decoder per client forever, so this one caches the decoders itself, per client identifier and a hash of the settings that decide the keys, and a client whose keys or algorithm were changed is verified against the new ones.
